第二天周六。中午一吃完饭，程安就钻进了自己的房间里，半个小时后，房门被砰砰的敲响了。程安过去开了门，夏晚安从外面钻进来，惊讶的瞪着程安床上那一片狼藉，“哥哥，你这是干嘛呀？”春夏秋冬的衣服都铺了一床，大夏天的，连羽绒服都没放过。夏晚安突然惊慌的往后退了两步，眼睛狐疑的在他房间扫了一圈，往他身后躲了躲：“哥，该不会你房间有老鼠吧？”正在找衣服打算出去约会的程安：“…………”他僵硬的扯出一抹笑，揉了揉夏晚安的头发：“宝宝，哥哥有正事儿要办，你先出去，明天我陪你出去玩。”夏晚安好奇：“什么正事儿？”程安唇角翘了翘，推着夏晚安出了门：“暑假告诉你，你哥现在最重要的是——高考。”“好吧，本来还想问你今天下午要不要跟我和有蔓还有韩知瑾一起去游乐场呢，那你慢慢办正事儿吧，我们走啦！”夏晚安冲他挥了挥手。关上门，程安忍不住轻笑了一声。今天一定得找个机会，把他跟小简单的名分确定下来，然后暑假就可以带着回来见见父母了，小简单笨是笨了点，但是他们家宝宝肯定会喜欢她的。程安一边美滋滋的想着，一边高贵冷艳的扫了一眼垃圾桶里碎到不再碎的碎片，呵，跟他抢人？下下下辈子，也没门儿。眼看着距离约定的时间已经快到了，程安只得随意挑选了一件白衬衫，急匆匆的出了门。到了约定地点，果然见到那个傻乎乎的笨小孩儿站在太阳底下，连个伞都没有撑。他走到她身边停下，抬手为她遮住了一点点阳光，然后手指勾住她的小辫子，问：“想去看电影吗？”秦书简惊讶的抬眸，阳光下的少年像是度上了一层光，美的熠熠闪光。她一时有些被惊到。只是那种感觉有些捉摸不到，她想不透，便放过了。她朝旁边看了看，好奇道：“就我们两个吗？”往常也一起看过电影，不过通常会带上胡三省的。程安挡在她额头上方的手顺势在她脑袋上轻拍了一下：“对，今天就我们两个。”然后很自然的抓住了她的手，朝着路边的公交站台走去。这次看电影的地方稍稍有些远，并肩坐在公交车上的时候，她的耳朵里被他塞进了一只耳机。听着轻缓的音乐，看着车窗外倒退的风景，晒着初夏午后暖洋洋的日光，没一会儿，秦书简就困了。小脑袋不住的一点一点的。程安好笑的用手轻轻将她的脑袋压在了自己的肩膀上，用手帮她挡住了车窗外晒进来的光。她卷翘的睫毛在他手心挡下来的阴影下，弯成一个个小勾子。每一个，都勾到了他心上。那一刻，程安是真的确定了。他想要她一辈子。ps：今天还有月票给我吗？

The next day is Saturday. As soon as he finished eating at noon, Cheng An went into his room. Half an hour later, there was a loud knock on the door. Cheng An went over and opened the door. Xia Wan'an came in from the outside and stared at the mess on Cheng An's bed in surprise, "Brother, what are you doing?" All spring, summer, autumn and winter clothes were spread out on the bed, including summer ones, including down jackets. Xia Wan'an suddenly took two steps back in panic, glanced around his room suspiciously, and hid behind him: "Brother, is there a mouse in your room?" Cheng An, who was looking for clothes to go out on a date: "..." He smiled stiffly and rubbed Xia Wan'an's hair: "Baby, brother, I have something serious to do. You go out first. I will accompany you out tomorrow. Let's go play." Xia Wan'an was curious: "What's the business?" Cheng An's lips curled up, and he pushed Xia Wan'an out: "The most important thing for your brother right now is the college entrance examination." "Okay, I wanted to ask you if you wanted to go to the amusement park with me, Youman and Han Zhijin this afternoon, so you can get down to business. Let's go!" After closing the door, Cheng An couldn't help but chuckle. We must find an opportunity today to confirm his relationship with Xiao JianJian, and then he can bring him back to meet his parents during the summer vacation. Xiao JianJian is a bit stupid, but their baby will definitely like her. Cheng An was thinking happily, while he glanced at the broken pieces in the trash can with a noble and cold look. Hey, are you trying to steal someone with him? There is no way for the next life. Seeing that the appointed time was approaching, Cheng An had no choice but to randomly pick a white shirt and hurried out the door. When we arrived at the appointed place, we saw that stupid kid standing in the sun without even an umbrella. He walked to her and stopped, raised his hand to cover her from the sun, then hooked his fingers into her pigtails and asked, "Want to go see a movie?" Qin Shujian raised his eyes in surprise. The young man in the sun seemed to be covered with a layer of light, and his beauty shone. She was a little shocked for a moment. It's just that the feeling was a bit elusive. She couldn't figure it out, so she let it go. She looked to the side and asked curiously, "Are we just the two of us?" We usually watched movies together, but usually we would bring Hu Sansheng with us. Cheng An's hand on her forehead patted her head gently: "Yes, it's just the two of us today." Then he naturally grabbed her hand and walked towards the bus stop on the roadside. This time, the movie was a little far away. When they were sitting side by side on the bus, he put an earphone in her ear. Listening to the gentle music, looking at the receding scenery outside the car window, and basking in the warm sunshine of the early summer afternoon, Qin Shujian felt sleepy after a while. The little head can't stop bit by bit. Cheng An smiled and gently pressed her head on his shoulder with his hand, and used his hand to help her block the light coming in from the car window. Her curled eyelashes curved into small hooks under the shadow of his palm. Every one of them touched his heart. At that moment, Cheng An was really sure. He wanted her forever. ps: Are there any monthly tickets for me today?
